headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 10, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 26.49%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 14.05%. This results in an average alpha of 12.44%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in value but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 48.66%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 17.30%, which still exceeds the SPY return. This outperformance is particularly relevant during times of market uncertainty, highlighting the portfolio's resilience relative to broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
